uploads.description: Choose the files to send, check the selection and press Upload. The SHA-256 fingerprint of each file is computed on this device and compared with the one of the received file.
uploads.dropDescription: or choose them from your device
uploads.waitForCurrent: Wait for the current upload to finish
uploads.keepOpenTitle: Keep the screen on and this page open
uploads.keepOpenDescription: If the phone locks or you switch to another app, the upload stops and the file has to be sent again.
uploads.hashError: Cannot read the file to compute its fingerprint
uploads.retry: Retry (moves it back to the selected files)
uploads.invalidLinkDescription: Open the page from the QR code or the full address shown on the computer receiving the files.

errors.ERR_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the maximum allowed size
errors.ERR_INVALID_TOKEN: Invalid or expired link: open the page again from the QR code
errors.ERR_BATCH_NOT_FOUND: The upload has already been closed: upload the files again
